title: MineFantasia-Resources
body:
This project includes all extensible resource packs for the mod [MineFantasia](https://modrinth.com/mod/minefantasia).

In this project, download the resources you wish to use and place them in the `resourcepacks` folder of your game installation directory.

As for the general synthesizer instrument added in mod version 0.0.9-beta, if you need to add a custom synth instrument resource pack, please go to the [MFPackager](https://github.com/Seikai-Takenawa/MFPackager) project on GitHub.
